title: Leftward sweep mark step
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean-tape Turing machine and $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean-tape Turing machine, with a Boolean loop parameter and input word $x$. For any natural number $m$, choice bit, input-head position, tape contents and head positions, and integer $z$, if the yard tape of length $m$ contains a mark at $z$, then one host-machine step from phase $p2$ leaves the phase and input head unchanged, advances every head of $A$’s work tapes by one, moves the yard head to $z-1$, and leaves the other tapes and output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Arbitrary simulated-machine tape contents and head positions
The yard tape contains true at $z$
